directional_observations: Credential-led and high-contrast titles repeatedly reached hundreds of thousands of views.
Large follower count was not required. Warren's 213,067-view YouTube video came from a channel with 3.04K subscribers at capture. DPRO's 195,819-view video came from a 25.7K-subscriber channel.
Controversial utility such as "right way," "exact protocol," and week-by-week expectations can substantially outperform channel size.
